     (= CONFIG_SND_FSI_AK4642 true)
     (= CONFIG_I2C true)
     (= CONFIG_SND_SOC_AK4642 true)
     (= CONFIG_SND_SOC_DA7210 true))
model:

  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_SND_SOC_AK4642 () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_SND_SOC_DA7210 () Bool
  true)

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_44/52/91/92/102 (66517915e09.c), dead store on 'codec_hw_write' at line 24. When all five configs (SND_FSI_DA7210, SND_FSI_AK4642, I2C, SND_SOC_AK4642, SND_SOC_DA7210) are all true, i2c_master_send IS defined and codec_hw_write is assigned and used as a function pointer in the real driver. This is a simplification artifact — the real code uses codec_hw_write in da7210_init() after it is assigned. The known vbdb bug is UndeclaredIdentifier for i2c_master_send when CONFIG_I2C=false; this config has I2C=true so that bug cannot appear here.
